messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired: SLO burn (p99) for /v1/embeddings in eu-west1. Alert: p99 latency > 3s for 5m, severity: P1. Link: https://grafana.example.com/d/embeddings-eu

oncall-jamie: acked the page, I'm on it :hand:

eli: seeing the same in traces — tail tokens spiking, a lot of long KV cache misses. No 5xxs yet.

carmen: quick check — any deploys in the last 30m? I don't see any from deploy-bot.

sam: autoscaler has been oscillating. min_replicas=2, current=2, desired=6 but scale-up stalled. Possible quota throttling.

oncall-jamie: pulling up pod logs and node metrics now.

eli: grafana: p50 120ms, p95 620ms, p99 3.8s. Tokenization time looks normal. Spike correlates with a subset of requests with long seq_len.

oncall-jamie: running quick scale to unblock traffic.

oncall-jamie: ```sh
# bump min replicas to force scale
kubectl patch hpa/embeddings-eu --type merge -p '{"spec": {"minReplicas": 6}}'
```

ops-bot: Scaling HPA applied: hpa/embeddings-eu minReplicas=6 by oncall-jamie.

sam: noted autoscaler events: "insufficient quota" for burst GPUs ~ eu-west1. That would explain stalled scale.

carmen: can we route new requests to fallback model (smaller quantized) while we warm capacity? Fallback has slightly worse quality but much lower latency.

eli: good idea. I'll flip the routing rule for eu-west1 to fallback-target for embeddings:{
  route: eu-west1 -> model: embed-small-v2
}

oncall-jamie: done. Routing change pushed, traffic shifting ~ 30% to fallback.

incident-bot: Incident update: routing change applied, autoscale forced, monitoring will report new latencies in 2m.

sam: after routing shift p99 dropped to 1.1s, p95 ~ 420ms. Looks much better. No customer errors.

carmen: customer impact assessment — preliminary: increased latency for a small % of users accessing long-context embeddings earlier, no failed requests. Customer-facing SLA ok, elevated latency only.

oncall-jamie: keeping the page open until autoscaler and pod pool fully recovered. I'll follow up with infra to request quota bump for eu-west1 burst capacity.

eli: probable root cause: a burst of long-sequence requests causing KV cache misses + autoscaler quota limit prevented fast scale. Follow-up action: add proactive warm pool and fallback routing for long-seq traffic.

ops-bot: Note created: INC-1766666123 - investigation task assigned to eng-runtime (eli, sam).

oncall-jamie: I'm going to hand off to eli for postmortem. Closing active ack in 10m if stable. Thanks everyone :heart:

incident-bot: PagerDuty: page acknowledged by oncall-jamie. Status: in_progress.

oncall-jamie: leaving final note — mitigation: routing -> embed-small-v2, forced HPA minReplicas=6. Next step: quota request and warm pool + add alert for autoscaler scale stalls.

eli: assigning follow-ups: (1) postmortem doc, (2) quota request to cloud infra, (3) add canary rule to route high-seq requests to fallback earlier.

sam: closing ops loop, will track quota ticket.

incident-bot: Incident update: resolved. p99 returned under threshold for 10m. Incident status: resolved.
